name: adsgpt
description: Create, review and optimize ad campaigns on the ad platforms connected to AdsGPT, such as Google Ads: the AdsGPT MCP server and the skills that guide it.

interface.longDescription: Create, review and optimize the ad campaigns of the accounts your organization connected to AdsGPT, such as Google Ads. A new campaign is a plan you approve once before it launches, paused; every other change asks for your approval too. Reports, queries and edits run on the AdsGPT MCP server, signed in with your AdsGPT account.
defaultPrompt: How did my Google Ads campaigns do last week?
